approved_scope.title: Preserve Cargo target files and same-name crate roots in generated specs
approved_scope.description: Preserve Cargo target files and same-name crate roots in generated specs
acceptance_criteria: Explicit Cargo binary targets retain their exact source files and workspace prefixes, while a binary sharing its package name keeps the package source root. Generation binds same-name source modules together with crate roots and never assigns an explicit target to a library or guessed filename owner. Existing configured and spec ownership remain respected.

answers.constraints: Preserve retained bounded single-read discovery; no ambient Cargo reread during generation. Keep directory scanning roots separate from exact target ownership. This corrects two reproduced review defects within the user-approved issue #813 fix; full local validation and confidence above 95 percent are required before merge.
